measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.method: gray<0.78 mask on the MNHN paratype photograph
measurements.source: threshold is a museum-background heuristic, not a published area fraction
measurements.note: value is measured on the photograph; reference 0.55 is a prior, not the measurement

measurements.name: analytic_turing_wavelength_nm
measurements.method: lambda = 2 pi / k_c with k_c from the Schnakenberg Jacobian at a=0.062, b=1.084, gamma=36
measurements.note: Pass 1 locks the analytic wavelength to the assignment by solving for D_u

measurements.name: dispersion_eigenvalue_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of closed-form σ(k) vs numpy.linalg.eigvals of J-k^2 D
measurements.note: formula-vs-eigenvalue check; the PDE wavelength sweep is Pass 2

measurements.name: pde_pattern_std
measurements.method: std of Schnakenberg u after IMEX integration
measurements.note: patterned std should exceed the initial noise

measurements.name: greigite_unit_cells_per_wavelength
measurements.source: Skinner, Erd and Grimaldi 1964, American Mineralogist 49:543-555
measurements.note: 2.0 nm is slightly more than two unit cells
